hypothesis.direction: Long after sweep below prior low and reclaim; short after sweep above prior high and reclaim.
hypothesis.entry_event: First completed reclaim close after sweep.
hypothesis.invalidation: Second close beyond swept extreme before entry.
hypothesis.known_prior_research: Distinct from ORB and VWAP; uses previous session extrema as liquidity pools.
hypothesis.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after reclaim.
hypothesis.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Candidate is anchored on prior-day high/low stop-run failure rather than opening range or VWAP state.
hypothesis.negative_expectation_falsifier: Reclaim does not outperform matched random entries around prior-day levels.
hypothesis.participants_or_behavior: Stop orders and breakout liquidity are absorbed; trapped breakout traders unwind; stronger hands reclaim value.
hypothesis.persistence_rationale: Prior-day extremes are visible liquidity pools; failed auction beyond them can create short-horizon directional flow.
hypothesis.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from entry to +30 completed minutes.
hypothesis.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles for current and prior complete session.
setup_state_machine: WAIT for current session sweep beyond level by minimum bps
REQUIRE completed close back inside prior range
EMIT away from swept level on next bar
hypothesis.single_emission_rule: At most one high sweep and one low sweep per symbol-session; first side only if both occur.
hypothesis.structural_premise: A sweep beyond prior-day high/low followed by reclaim marks failed stop-run liquidity and continuation away from the swept level.
